from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import Descriptors
mw_ch4 = Descriptors.MolWt(Chem.MolFromSmiles('C'))
mw_co2 = Descriptors.MolWt(Chem.MolFromSmiles('O=C=O'))
mass_ch4 = facts['mass_methane']['magnitude']
ratio = facts['carbon_ratio_ch4_to_co2']['magnitude']
moles_ch4 = mass_ch4 / mw_ch4
moles_co2 = moles_ch4 * ratio
